searchText: <@!574864862338088960> For a first EIP, you did much better than many experienced EIP authors. 🙂 <@!301186049323958275> I addressed your comments. Is it normal that the CI keeps failing ? <@!301186049323958275> I might be wrong but i believe that the CURL examples for eth_getUncleByBlockHashAndIndex and eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex are wrong in EIP-1474 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-1474.md#example-26 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-1474.md#example-27 They don't match the returns section They should have the same return as eth_getBlockByHash and eth_getBlockByNumber BTW <@!301186049323958275> At first i wanted to create an EIP for eth_getTransactionReceipt as well. But thinking more about it i believe we can let it as is because there is no information about gas price in the current response. Only about gas used. So IMO that would be useless to add the miner bribe, the fee cap or the base fee. What do you think ? <@!574864862338088960> You should definitely submit a PR to 1474 if you believe it is incorrect. 🙂 Left a couple comments that should satisfy the bot (CI). > At first i wanted to create an EIP for eth_getTransactionReceipt as well. But thinking more about it i believe we can let it as is because there is no information about gas price in the current response. Only about gas used. So IMO that would be useless to add the miner bribe, the fee cap or the base fee. What do you think ? <@!574864862338088960> I'm fine with no changes to returned receipts.

excerpts.author: abdel.stark
excerpts.content: They should have the same return as eth_getBlockByHash and eth_getBlockByNumber

excerpts.author: abdel.stark
excerpts.content: BTW <@!301186049323958275> At first i wanted to create an EIP for eth_getTransactionReceipt as well. But thinking more about it i believe we can let it as is because there is no information about gas price in the current response. Only about gas used. So IMO that would be useless to add the miner bribe, the fee cap or the base fee. What do you think ?
